requiredReceipt.paths: production-pr, maintainer-infrastructure-pr, main, default-token-ai-draft: exact head, runUrl, observedAt, logical-name to observed-context map and check name/head/status/conclusion/url. AI adds tokenKind=github.token, draft=true and explicitCallHead.
requiredReceipt.protection: Owner/date, raw settings receipt path, effective required contexts after evaluating branch protection/rulesets/bypass, and actual failed-check/missing-check blocking observations with head/date/URL.
requiredReceipt.release: Existing authorized release run URL/head and actual validation prerequisite before release, or leave unknown. Never publish as a probe.
requiredReceipt.limitations: Offline verifier checks completeness/consistency, not authenticity, settings enforcement or owner approval. Do not fill observations from synthetic tests. Unknown stays open. No secrets in receipts.
